body:
gm frens. I would like to provide an update on this proposal - and request to put this proposal on hold. Reason:

I am currently brainstorming how to approach the content to create at the Polkadot conference, and exploring if I can work on an alternate format instead of an interview series described here.

If I am to conduct the interview series and incorporate EdgewareDAO, I will revisit and request to continue the proposal and figure out if it can be processed retroactively.

Given this proposal is in the early phases, I hope putting this on pause does not affect or inconvenience EdgewareDAO in any way.

Also, I would still love to explore the opportunity of collaborating on a different content series in the future if not at this event.

I am happy to answer any questions take any suggestions here or on discord.
